mechanism: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) reduces primaquine's oxidative metabolite formation by lowering pH and reducing oxidation, potentially decreasing antimalarial efficacy and altering hemolytic toxicity risk in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor therapeutic efficacy of primaquine and consider separating administration timing; counsel patients to avoid high-dose vitamin C supplementation during primaquine therapy, particularly in G6PD-deficient individuals.
